يتمركز (form IIq)
# يَتَمَرْكَزُ (yatamarkazu) /ja.ta.mar.ka.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# يُتَمَرْكَزُ (yutamarkazu) /ju.ta.mar.ka.zu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَمَرْكَزَ (tamarkaza)
# يَتَمَرْكَزَ (yatamarkaza) /ja.ta.mar.ka.za/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
